title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun
description: The famous “Seven Wonders” that every school seems to have are a staple of Japanese urban legends. One of the most well-known of these tales is that of Hanako-san: the ghost of a young girl who haunts the school’s bathrooms.Kamome Academy has its own version of Hanako-san’s legend. Rumors claim that if one successfully manages to summon Hanako-san, she will grant her summoner any wish. Lured by the gossip, many people have tried to call upon her, yet every attempt has failed. However, when Nene Yashiro, a girl hoping for romantic fortune, dares to summon Hanako-san, she discovers that the rumored “girl” is actually a boy!After a series of unfortunate events involving Nene’s romantic desires, she is unwillingly entangled in the world of the supernatural, becoming Hanako-kun’s assistant. Soon, she finds out about Hanako-kun’s lesser-known duty: maintaining the fragile balance between mortals and apparitions.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x1
episodes_data.description: Yashiro Nene is looking for ghostly help with her love life, but when "Hanako-san," the wish-granting spirit that haunts a girls’ bathroom stall, turns out to be a boy, she may end up getting more, and less, than she bargained for.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x2
episodes_data.description: A rash of mysterious thefts hits the school, and rumor has it that the apparition "Yousei-san" is behind it. When Nene catches sight of the creature, will she end up losing more than just her school supplies?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x3
episodes_data.description: Nene’s best friend vanishes without a trace and no one else remembers she ever existed! To get her friend back, Nene is forced to call on Hanako for help and journey into a "Boundary" between the world of the living and the world of the dead.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x4
episodes_data.description: Nene, Hanako, and Kou have reached the top of the Misaki Stairs, where a mysterious and bewitching woman awaits them. Will Nene get her friend back, or will she vanish along with her?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x5
episodes_data.description: The school is full on unlikely couples thanks to a tree that rumor has it makes any confession made under it succeed. When Hanako asks Nene to meet him there, Nene starts to suspect that he sees her as more than an assistant.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x6
episodes_data.description: In search of Hanako’s secrets, Nene and Kou enter the fifth Wonder, the 4 O’clock Library. Its books contain the past and future of every student their school has ever had, but some knowledge comes at a price.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x7
episodes_data.description: Nene’s relationship with Hanako becomes strained after she learns about his past. With some baking help from Kou, she tries to talk things out with Hanako over donuts, but their heart-to-heart is interrupted by a shocking intruder!

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x8
episodes_data.description: Kou gets more than he bargained for when he tries to help a student’s ghost rest in peace. The late Mitsuba may look delicate, but his language is anything but. Can Kou put up with him long enough to help him?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x9
episodes_data.description: After a surprise invitation, Nene finds herself kidnapped and taken to... a fancy tea party? Nene quickly drops her guard in coversation with the beautiful and mysterious Sakura, but is their meeting as innocent as it seems?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x10
episodes_data.description: Nene finds disembodied hands appearing in her old club photos! Then, hands start sprouting around her in real life too! They seem harmless, but is there something sinister behind them?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x11
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa rescues Nene and Mitsuba from the Hell of Mirrors, but does the mercurial ghost have something worse in store for them? Meanwhile, Hanako and Kou race to find a way to follow Nene, but will they make it in time?

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun 1x12
episodes_data.description: Nene made it back from the Hell of Mirrors in one piece, but she worries about what Hanako may be hiding from her. Just then, strange fish appear, calling her their princess and asking her to join them as the mermaid’s successor.

episodes_data.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Nene doesn't have long to live. While Kou struggles with the revelation, Nene goes about her day none the wiser. Only she can't seem to find Hanako.
